blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Mark Villar expressed his support on Monday for Senate Bill No. 1431, or the proposed Revised Cooperative Code of the Philippines, which aims to strengthen cooperatives as instruments of social justice, livelihood generation, and economic development. Cooperatives have been making significant contributions to the economy, Villar explained in a statement, citing data from the Cooperative Development Authority, showing that the country has more than 20,000 registered cooperatives employing around 335,100 workers as of 2024. He stressed that cooperatives help improve the livelihoods of farmers, fisherfolk, rural workers, and other sectors by providing financial, technical, and educational support […]...
